entries.title: What this chapter is about
entries.summary: The last two chapters start here
items: essentialcraft5:shade_core

blocks.text: Demons make no promises. The rare few who won an oath from one paid with something taken from the deepest dark. It is scarce even in hell, and the demon held it the way a man holds fire.

Fitting the Computer Guy's Suit with modules finishes Chapter 21. Two chapters remain. This one takes you to the Shadow Corrupted Land for materials and raises the pentacle. The next, [[apex/intro]], summons the Heart of Calamity, and the main line ends once it falls.

Stand 4 shade pillars around the pentacle to reach tier 4
With enough renown, swear the oath to a demon for a Demon's Oath

cells: Reach matrix rank 8 on the tier 4 pentacle

blocks.text: What to stock up on

items.text: {item:essentialcraft5:umbral_crystal}: for Shade Cores, shade pillars and the oath; each entry gives the count.
{item:essentialcraft5:shade_core}: about 9 across both chapters, 1 for each of the 4 pillars, 2 for the Calamity Beacon, 1 for rank 8 and 2 for rank 9.
{item:essentialcraft5:shade_core}: about 6 across both chapters, 1 for each of the 4 pillars and 2 for the Calamity Beacon.

items: 4 {item:essentialcraft5:demonic_crystal_pillar}s, which go in the middle of the shade pillar recipe and are used up. Leave the 4 on your tier 3 pentacle alone and make 4 more.

blocks.text: Each Shade Core takes an Enrichment Chamber {cfg:machines.enrichment_chamber.shade.seconds|div:60|round:1} minutes of collapse, so build two or three chambers early and let them run together while you gather crystals and trade for renown.
In this world an Enrichment Chamber can't make Shade Cores, so the steps here that need one can't be done.
In the original you could also absorb a Shade Matrix Projection and turn your matrix shade, but the shade type did nothing at all, and no weapon went with it.

entries.title: Shade Matrix
items: essentialcraft5:shade_matrix_projection

blocks.text: Goal: absorb a {item:essentialcraft5:shade_matrix_projection} and turn your matrix type to Shade.

Shade [[matrix/alignment|Alignment]] only works from matrix rank 8, starting straight at II and reaching III at rank 9. You can switch while still below rank 8; the type stays with you and starts working once you get there.
Your matrix type has no passive effect on its own; turning it shade is the first step of this chapter.

Prepare: an {item:essentialcraft5:empty_matrix_projection} and a {item:essentialcraft5:dark_soul_matter}. Make the Shade Matrix Projection in a Radiating Chamber, with the blank projection in the top slot and the dark soul matter in the bottom slot; any balance works.

items: Right-click the projection once and let go. It takes your matrix imprint, and only you can use it from then on.
Find somewhere without monsters, have food ready, and hold right-click for 10 seconds.
When it finishes, the projection vanishes, chat says your matrix has twisted into a new color, and your type is now shade.

blocks.title: Done when
blocks.text: You finish absorbing a Shade Matrix Projection and your matrix type becomes Shade.

blocks.title: Pitfall
blocks.text: Absorbing has a cost: Wither, Weakness, Slowness, Mining Fatigue and Hunger at once, plus a spell of blindness ([[gear/projection_use]]). Absorb a different projection later and your type changes with it, so getting back to shade takes another shade projection.
Fine print

items: Shade Alignment cuts magic damage that has an attacker by {cfg:general.matrix_rank.resonance.shade.magic_reduction|at:1|pct} at II and {cfg:general.matrix_rank.resonance.shade.magic_reduction|at:2|pct} at III. Damage with no attacker, such as corruption effects or MRU Corruption, is not reduced.
A weapon with Matrix Traits heals you for {cfg:general.guns.lens_drain_percent|pctv} of each hit's damage, also only from rank 8 ([[matrix/alignment]]).

entries.title: Gathering Umbral Crystals
entries.summary: Clusters in shadow land, richer at night
items: essentialcraft5:umbral_crystal

blocks.text: Goal: collect 16 {item:essentialcraft5:umbral_crystal}s. These two chapters use far more than that, but 16 at once ticks this step.

Umbral Crystals grow in the [[hoanna/lands|Shadow Corrupted Land]] of Hoanna. Right-click a ripe {item:essentialcraft5:umbral_cluster} to gather it. It drops back to a dim spent cluster that stays where it is and slowly grows again ([[hoanna_explore/specialties]]).

cells: Only in the Shadow Corrupted Land, at night or during Darkness; about one game day
Only in the Shadow Corrupted Land at night; about one game day

blocks.text: Where they go

items: Each [[shade/shade_pillar|shade pillar]] takes 3, and tier 4 needs 4 pillars.

items.text: Raising the Computer Guy's Suit or the Verdict Blade to attunement stage 5 takes 4 per piece ([[apex/ascension]]).

blocks.title: Done when
blocks.text: You have 16 Umbral Crystals in your inventory at once.

blocks.title: Pitfall
blocks.text: Days are lean, so go at night. Don't mine a ripe cluster with a pickaxe. You get the same as a right-click, but the cluster is gone and never grows back.
During Darkness, daytime gathering counts as night and spent clusters regrow by day too ([[hoanna_explore/calamity_windows]]).
Fine print

items: [[bestiary/inquisitorium_patroller|Inquisitorium Patrollers]] spawn in the Shadow Corrupted Land whatever the light, so go armed even by day.
A patch of shadow land doesn't hold many clusters, and once picked they take a game day to return. When several of you play together, split up the patches so nobody waits on anybody.
Chapter 19's Inquisitorium Coordinates point into the Shadow Corrupted Land, so follow them if you haven't found one yet ([[inquisitorium/journey]]).

entries.title: {item:essentialcraft5:shade_core}
entries.summary: The third thing a chamber can collapse into
items: essentialcraft5:shade_core

blocks.text: Goal: build an Enrichment Chamber in the Shadow Corrupted Land, drop Umbral Crystals into it, and collapse your first {item:essentialcraft5:shade_core}.

Collapse is the craft from Chapter 16 ([[hoanna/collapse]]). With the chamber in the Shadow Corrupted Land and Umbral Crystals inside, it no longer collapses into a Void Core or a Reactor but into a Shade Core.

An Enrichment Chamber in the Shadow Corrupted Land with Umbral Crystals inside will, given time, collapse into a Shade Core that drops in its middle. [[enrichment/controller]] covers building the chamber.
In this world an Enrichment Chamber can't make Shade Cores.
What it takes

rows: The Shadow Corrupted Land in Hoanna, or within {cfg:machines.enrichment_chamber.shade.site_radius} blocks of it. The controller itself and the eight points {cfg:machines.enrichment_chamber.shade.site_radius} blocks away in each straight and diagonal direction are checked, and one of the nine in shadow land is enough

A formed Enrichment Chamber whose shell holds at least {cfg:machines.enrichment_chamber.shade.casing} {item:essentialcraft5:void_stone}, {item:essentialcraft5:void_glass} and {item:essentialcraft5:demonic_plating} blocks combined
An {item:essentialcraft5:ec_balancer} in the shell, as for any collapse
One holding a full {cfg:machines.enrichment_chamber.collapse.presence_mru} MRU, shut inside

At least {cfg:machines.enrichment_chamber.shade.mru}. The controller alone stores {cfg:machines.enrichment_chamber.max_mru}, and each [[enrichment/holding_chamber|Holding Block]] in the shell adds {cfg:machines.enrichment_chamber.mru_per_storage}, so add more if it doesn't fit
{cfg:machines.enrichment_chamber.shade.umbral} {item:essentialcraft5:umbral_crystal}s lying inside the chamber, eaten when it collapses

blocks.text: While every condition holds, progress rises by 1 a second, and at {cfg:machines.enrichment_chamber.shade.seconds} seconds, or {cfg:machines.enrichment_chamber.shade.seconds|div:60|round:1} minutes, it collapses.

During a darkness [[hoanna/events|calamity]] in Hoanna, each second counts as {cfg:machines.enrichment_chamber.collapse.event_multiplier}. Other calamities give no speed-up, unlike the collapse in chapter 16.
The [[hoanna_explore/tide|mana tide]] speeds it up as well, to 1.5 seconds per second at the full moon. During darkness the calamity rate applies instead, and the two never stack.
The [[hoanna_explore/tide|mana tide]] speeds it up as well, to 1.5 seconds per second at the full moon.

When it collapses the MRUCU disappears, {cfg:machines.enrichment_chamber.shade.mru} MRU and {cfg:machines.enrichment_chamber.shade.umbral} Umbral Crystals are used up, and a Shade Core drops in the middle. It piles separately from Void Cores, Reactors and Condensed Matrices, and stops at full progress once its pile reaches 64.

Shade Cores come first. With the right place and enough crystals, the chamber makes Shade Cores whatever the balance, and condensing waits too. Short of crystals or in the wrong place, it collapses and condenses by balance as before.
How to do it

items: Pick a spot at the edge of the Shadow Corrupted Land, ideally in the neighboring land and less than {cfg:machines.enrichment_chamber.shade.site_radius} blocks from it.

items.text: Build the chamber as in [[hoanna/collapse]] with at least {cfg:machines.enrichment_chamber.shade.casing} Void Stone, Void Glass or Demonic Plating blocks, plus the controller, Holding Blocks, a Stabilizer and preferably a [[enrichment/monitoring|State Checker]].

Build the chamber as in [[enrichment/controller]] with at least {cfg:machines.enrichment_chamber.shade.casing} Void Stone, Void Glass or Demonic Plating blocks in the shell, plus the controller, Holding Blocks, a Stabilizer and preferably a [[enrichment/monitoring|State Checker]].

items: Shut an MRUCU in and let it fill, then pump in {cfg:machines.enrichment_chamber.shade.mru} MRU through an Acceptor.
Open one shell block, throw {cfg:machines.enrichment_chamber.shade.umbral} Umbral Crystals inside, and put the block back.
Right-click the controller or check the State Checker to make sure it is on the Shade Core path and nothing is missing, then wait.

blocks.title: Done when
blocks.text: You pick up your first Shade Core.

blocks.title: Pitfall
blocks.text: Inquisitorium Patrollers spawn in the Shadow Corrupted Land whatever the light. A chamber in the neighboring land, within {cfg:machines.enrichment_chamber.shade.site_radius} blocks of it, still counts, and patrollers normally never spawn there. During Darkness they spawn on all land, so they can still find you then.
Fine print

items: The State Checker turns the collapse bar purple while it works on a Shade Core, and hovering over it shows what is missing: the wrong place, or how many crystals the shell still lacks.
Crystals that land outside the shell or get washed out by water don't count.
Collapse uses up the MRUCU. For another core, push in a new one, let it fill and drop in another {cfg:machines.enrichment_chamber.shade.umbral} crystals.
Several chambers can work at once without affecting each other. The main line needs a fair number of cores, so two or three chambers save the most time.

entries.title: {item:essentialcraft5:shade_crystal_pillar}
entries.summary: The top pillar, needed for tier 4
items: essentialcraft5:shade_crystal_pillar

blocks.text: Goal: make a {item:essentialcraft5:shade_crystal_pillar} at the Magician Table. A [[shade/tier4|tier 4 pentacle]] needs 4.

The shade pillar is the highest of the five crystal pillars. It gathers ESPE {cfg:machines.mithriline_crystal_pillar.tier_multipliers|at:4} times as fast as a mithriline pillar, and its base adds 120 to an enchanting table ([[mithriline/crystal_pillar]]).

Prepare: a {item:essentialcraft5:demonic_crystal_pillar} in the middle and, in the four corners, 1 {item:essentialcraft5:shade_core} and 3 {item:essentialcraft5:umbral_crystal}s, one per slot, plus MRU in the Magician Table; the recipe page shows how much.

blocks.title: Done when
blocks.text: You make your first SHADE Corrupted Crystal Pillar.

blocks.title: Pitfall
blocks.text: The Demonic Crystal Pillar in the middle is used up. Tier 4 is built on top of tier 3, so none of the 4 demonic pillars already on the pentacle can come down. Make 4 more, which means another 24 Ackronite Ingots ([[pentacle/tier_three]]).
In the original, the SHADE Corrupted Crystal Pillar had no recipe. It was only in the creative inventory and never turned up in survival.
Goal: raise your Chapter 12 Soul Pentacle to tier 4. Ranks 8 and 9 both have to be reached on a tier 4 pentacle.
Goal: raise your Chapter 12 Soul Pentacle to tier 4.

Tier 4 cures the same corruption effects as tier 3, and every point of ESPE in the pillars still counts as two. The 4 extra shade pillars gather fastest of all, so the pentacle has more ESPE to draw on.
Every point of ESPE in the pillars still counts as two at tier 4. The 4 extra shade pillars gather fastest of all, so the pentacle has more ESPE to draw on.

rows: Left whole, every block in place ([[pentacle/tier_three]])
Grows from 5 × 5 to 7 × 7, with the 4 shade pillars on the corners

blocks.text: The tier 4 layout

items: Keep the tier 3 layout whole.
Following the 3D view above, stand 4 shade pillars outside the tier 3 layout, each on a block of {item:essentialcraft5:void_stone}.
Right-click the pentacle center and open its screen to check the tier.

blocks.title: Done when
blocks.text: The runes turn dark purple and the screen shows tier 4.

blocks.title: Pitfall
blocks.text: Every pillar has to sit exactly where the 3D view shows it; one block off and the tier doesn't form. Switch the view to flat to check it layer by layer.
Using it
Tier 4 draws ESPE from 24 pillars, each point counting as two. Curing an effect takes the same from the pillars as tier 3, half what the lower tiers take.
Fine print

items.text: Which tier can cure which corruption effect is the same at 4 as at 3 ([[pentacle/cure]]).

items: Summon a [[bestiary/matrix_shade|Matrix Specter]] on a tier 4 pentacle and the reserved ESPE comes from all 24 pillars, and goes back to them if you lose.
Lose a shade pillar and the pentacle drops back to tier 3 until you replace it.

entries.title: Sworn: The Oath
entries.summary: Hand over crystals for a Demon's Oath
items: essentialcraft5:demon_oath

blocks.text: Goal: raise your Demonic Renown to {cfg:general.demon.standing.oath}, swear the oath to a demon and receive a {item:essentialcraft5:demon_oath}.
Goal: get a {item:essentialcraft5:demon_oath}.

Every trade you complete with a demon adds 1 to your Demonic Renown ([[demons/standing]]). At {cfg:general.demon.standing.oath} you reach the last tier, <hl>Sworn</hl>, and a demon will take your Umbral Crystals and hear an oath. The trades you made for Ackronite all count, so by this chapter you are probably not far off.
In this world demons pay no attention to renown and nobody can swear the oath, so there is no Demon's Oath and the next chapter's Calamity Beacon can't be made.
Prepare: at least {cfg:general.demon.standing.oath_cost} {item:essentialcraft5:umbral_crystal}s in your inventory, and a summoned demon ([[demons/summoning]]).

items: Summon a demon.
Sneak and right-click it with Umbral Crystals in your main hand or off hand.
The demon takes {cfg:general.demon.standing.oath_cost} crystals, gives you a Demon's Oath and leaves.

blocks.title: Done when
blocks.text: You receive a Demon's Oath.

blocks.title: Pitfall
blocks.text: Only the player who summoned the demon can swear; someone else right-clicking it doesn't count. The oath isn't a trade, so your renown stays the same, and the demon leaves. Summon another if you still want Ackronite.
Fine print

items: Crystals spread across several slots are counted together, so the stack in your hand doesn't need {cfg:general.demon.standing.oath_cost} on its own.
If your renown is under {cfg:general.demon.standing.oath} or you are short of crystals, the action bar says what is missing and nothing is taken.
The Demon's Oath only goes into next chapter's [[apex/beacon|Calamity Beacon]], so one is enough.

entries.title: Rank 8 · Shade
entries.summary: Shade Alignment, and the Calamity Beacon

blocks.text: Goal: reach matrix rank 8, Shade.
You need

rows: 30 kinds in all, at least 8 of them killed in Hoanna, 1 from the End and 3 Essential Craft creatures ([[matrix/codex]])
A tier 4 Soul Pentacle, which you just built
100,000 MRU in the Crucible and 12,000 ESPE in the pentacle's pillars

cells: 9 in all, up to 4 at once; 104 health each, 11 damage a hit; 140 seconds

blocks.text: For the End kind, a shulker or the Ender Dragon will do. Essential Craft creatures are this mod's own monsters: everything in the bestiary counts, and so do the ones you fought earlier, such as wind mages and the Holographic Projection ([[bestiary/overview]]).
How

items: Place the offerings in the Crucible's offering slots and fill it with enough MRU through a Bound Gem.
Stand within 3 blocks with your bound Soul Stone in your main hand, open the screen, and once everything on the right is ticked, start the trial.

items.text: Defeat enough Matrix Echoes, and don't stray far from the Crucible.
Stay next to the Crucible without moving or getting hurt until the channel finishes.

blocks.title: Done when
blocks.text: "Rank 8 · Shade" appears in the middle of the screen, and your Soul Stone's tooltip shows matrix rank 8.
Rank 8 gives you this: if your matrix is shade, [[matrix/alignment|Shade Alignment]] starts working here, straight at II. Your reservoir grows to {cfg:general.matrix_rank.pool_per_rank|mul:7}.
The Calamity Beacon needs rank 8, and the next chapter starts with it ([[apex/beacon]]).
The Calamity Beacon needs matrix rank {cfg:general.matrix_rank.gates.calamity_beacon}, and the next chapter starts with it ([[apex/beacon]]).
